about.text: Appellees Lisa Baker, Jacqueline Dougherty, Keyanna Jones, and Amelia Weltner, live in DeKalb County, outside the city limits of Atlanta (“the City”). They desire to collect signatures inside the City as part of a local referendum petition aimed at repealing a city ordinance that authorized the lease of land owned by the City in Dekalb County to the Atlanta Police Federation for the construction of a new training facility.

caseName: Lisa Baker v. City of Atlanta, et al
